defective_pattern: Emitting conversational reports or dialogues in Persian due to context bleed from inspecting or parsing Persian artifacts.
why_defective: Violates Directive 6 (English-Only conversational interaction). The agent must deliberately switch its conversational output language back to English after reading non-English artifacts before emitting messages to the user.
observed_symptoms: Stage completion report emitted in Persian
User feedback on English speaking rule violation
Contaminated working memory causing context bleed
corrective_remedy: Decouple artifact target language from conversational orchestration language. After parsing non-English artifacts, the agent must deliberately switch its conversational output language back to English before emitting messages to the user.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of non-English characters in orchestration or conversational reports.
